claim.basis: Issuer-reported non-GAAP adjusted EPS guidance in an SEC-filed results exhibit; the maintained valuation uses the range explicitly rather than treating it as GAAP EPS.

evidence.applicability_limit: Supports only RTX's stated adjusted EPS and free-cash-flow guidance; it does not validate GAAP comparability, valuation multiples, or delivery after the filing date.
evidence.excerpt: Adjusted EPS guidance remains USD 7.10-7.25 and free-cash-flow guidance remains USD 8.50-8.75 billion.
evidence.rationale: The inspected SEC-filed issuer exhibit directly states the adjusted EPS range used as the scenario earnings anchor.

claim.proposition: RTX reported full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of USD 7.10 to USD 7.25 per share in its Q2 results exhibit.
claim.scope: RTX Corporation consolidated adjusted earnings guidance for fiscal 2026
claim.uncertainty: Guidance is issuer-defined non-GAAP information and may change with program charges, Pratt remediation, demand, execution, tax, or other excluded items.
